name: B10-0115/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Situation in Northeast Syria, the violence against civilians and the need to maintain a sustainable ceasefire
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Northeast Syria, the violence against civilians and the need to maintain a sustainable ceasefire
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the fighting in northeast Syria and calling for action. It asks all sides to respect the ceasefire and protect civilians, especially Kurds. It wants the Syrian government to investigate abuses, let aid through, and treat detained people lawfully. It also asks European countries to bring home their citizens from camps and not to send Syrian refugees back while the situation stays unsafe.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and set of requests to other bodies.
- **Who it affects:** Syrians in the conflict zone, detained foreign nationals, and Syrian refugees in Europe.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and the Syrian interim government.
